scope: 2x2 mesh, two real TimingSimpleCPU cores, ancient router/HNF/SNF, native CHI L2; cold Linux boot and actual root login at 100MHz
limitations: Native L2 warm checkpoint serialization and restore are not implemented.
Linux login acceptance uses 100MHz; the platform default remains 1GHz.
This preserves the ancient exclusive-only HNF profile, not the other branch full shared-read/CMO protocol profile.

console_evidence.normalization: Removed serial carriage returns and trailing line whitespace in the committed text copy; raw terminal remains in the run output directory.
